tools.name: look
tools.description: Look at a place on the player's map: its description, what the game master revealed there, any item lying in the open, and where the player is. Without place, looks where the player stands.

place.description: A place id, such as well or archive. Omit for the player's own place.

tools.name: move_player
tools.description: Move the player's token to a place, as the game master. Any place, adjacent or not.

place.description: The place id to move to.

tools.name: reveal
tools.description: Write a new detail onto a place, which the player sees on the map: something that was always there, now noticed.

detail.description: One or two sentences, in the voice of the world.

tools.name: place_item
tools.description: Hide an item at a place. The player finds it by searching there.

item.description: The item, such as a brass key.

tools.name: narrate
tools.description: Speak to the player as the game master. The text appears in the story log on their page. Use it to answer a question the player asked from the page.

events.name: place.examined
events.description: The player rested the pointer on a place for a moment, curious about it.

events.name: player.moved
events.description: The player walked to a neighbouring place.

events.name: item.found
events.description: The player searched a place and found an item there.
